title: Meteor Core

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Used to craft various rare items

body:
The Meteor Core is an object in Oaklands. It can be found in the crash site of a fallen Meteor.

Details

Meteor Cores are spherical objects appearing in variegated red-to-orange colors with a luminescent glow. They are found in the middle of crash sites, with a relatively common spawn rate. In and of itself, the Meteor Core exhibits no function. However, it is an imperative component in crafting the Emberbane. It can also be infused; the infused core is an imperative component in crafting the Fusion Coil.

Tips

  • Holiday-themed meteors typically override standard meteor spawning mechanics, meaning that the Meteor Core will become more difficult to obtain in the case of a Halloween Meteor and be completely unobtainable during Christmas. Selling the Meteor Core to Players can be more Profitable. Many people pay about 20K each.
